fullPassage: By enhancing energy efficiency and putting waste products to use, biopower helps move utilities and industries in a sustainable direction. The U.S. forest products industry now obtains half its energy by combusting woody waste and liquid waste from pulp mill processing. Biopower helps alleviate climate change as well by reducing carbon dioxide emissions, and capturing landfill gas reduces emissions of methane, a potent greenhouse gas. Biopower also benefits human health as it cuts down on pollution; by replacing coal in co-firing and direct combustion, biopower reduces emissions of sulfur dioxide because plant matter, unlike coal, contains no appreciable sulfur content. When plant matter is burned for power, soil is deprived of nutrients and organic matter it would have gained from the plant matter's decomposition. In addition, biomass resources tend to be geographically spread out, so using them can help support rural economies and reduce many nations' dependence on imported fuels.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바이오매스는 지리적으로 퍼져 있어 농촌 경제를 지원할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ② increase urban pollution
✅ ① help support rural economies
❌ ③ accelerate climate change
❌ ④ deplete natural resources
✅② help support rural economies: 원문과 일치
❌① increase pollution: 반대
❌③ accelerate climate change: 반대
❌④ deplete resources: 반대
det.tip: geographically spread out → rural economies 지원

questions.passage: By enhancing energy efficiency and putting waste products to use, biopower helps move utilities and industries in a sustainable direction. The U.S. forest products industry now obtains half its energy by combusting woody waste and liquid waste from pulp mill processing. Biopower helps alleviate climate change as well by reducing carbon dioxide emissions, and capturing landfill gas reduces emissions of methane, a potent greenhouse gas. Biopower also benefits human health as it cuts down on pollution; by replacing coal in co-firing and direct combustion, biopower reduces emissions of sulfur dioxide because plant matter, unlike coal, contains no appreciable sulfur content. However, one downside is that _____. In addition, biomass resources tend to be geographically spread out, so using them can help support rural economies and reduce many nations' dependence on imported fuels.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: more greenhouse gases are released than from coal
rural economies suffer from lack of biomass
soil loses the nutrients it would have gained from the plant matter's natural decomposition

det.korean: 식물을 태우면 토양이 분해로 얻었을 영양분을 잃는 상충관계가 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② sulfur dioxide emissions actually increase
❌ ① more greenhouse gases are released than from coal
❌ ③ rural economies suffer from lack of biomass
❌ ④ soil loses the nutrients it would have gained from the plant
✅① soil loses nutrients: 원문의 단점
❌② more greenhouse: 반대 (바이오파워가 줄임)
❌③ rural suffer: 반대 (바이오파워가 지원)
❌④ sulfur increase: 반대
det.tip: trade-off: 바이오파워의 장점(배출 감소) vs 단점(토양 영양분 손실)
